datasets.name: W5E5
datasets.description: WFDE5 over Land merged with ERA5 over Ocean

metadata.notes: Reference dataset for ISIMIP3b bias adjustment.
Bias-adjusted & statistically downscaled by ISIMIP3b protocol.

datasets.name: HOSTRADA
datasets.description: Hourly Station-based and Raster-based Terrestrial Atmospheric Dataset (HOSTRADA)

metadata.notes: Gridded hourly surface climate data over Germany on a regular lat/lon grid (EPSG:4326). Files are monthly NetCDF, named {var}_1hr_HOSTRADA-v1-0_BE_gn_{YYYYMMDDHH}-{YYYYMMDDHH}.nc.

datasets.name: AGRI_ISIMIP
datasets.description: Agricultural Impact Model Outputs from ISIMIP

metadata.notes: Agricultural model outputs driven by CMIP6 climate projections. Available for multiple crop models, ESMs, experiments, and irrigation conditions. Includes yields, biomass, plant year, and other agricultural metrics.
